exposure: pre-operative vaginal cleansing with povidone iodine
cohort: The study included 200 pregnant women undergoing elective Cesarean section, divided into a control group (standard abdominal scrub) and an experimental group (vaginal povidone iodine preparation in addition to standard scrub).
finding: Pre-operative vaginal cleansing with povidone iodine reduced the risk of post-Cesarean endometritis, but did not significantly decrease the overall risk of post-operative wound infection or fever.
